title: SubplotLedger Event
description: Append-only event log for subplot lifecycle. Distinct from PromiseLedger (which tracks narrative promises); this ledger tracks subplots opened with resolution targets. Prevents subplots from being abandoned without resolution. Feeds Subplot section of Author Dashboard.

scene_id.description: Scene where this subplot event occurred.

subplot_id.description: Unique subplot identifier. Consistent across all events for the same subplot.

subplot_type.description: Subplot category. Romantic subplots are tracked by IntimacyEscalationLedger in parallel.

status.description: 'abandoned' is a hard fail for any subplot with priority >= 3.

description.description: Short description of the subplot (e.g. 'Protagonist's rift with her sister over the family business').

opened_at_scene.description: Scene where this subplot was opened. Populated on the 'opened' event.

target_resolution_scene.description: Planned scene for resolution. Null if unscheduled. Convergence Controller checks for overdue subplots.

resolution_scene.description: Actual scene where resolved. Null until status = resolved.
